sources.snippet: Thanks to FlagOS’s unified multi-chip AI system software stack, MiniCPM5-2B was adapted to 9 different AI chips in an extremely short time. Currently, the multi-chip version of MiniCPM5-2B has been released on FlagRelease, FlagOS’s platform for automatic migration, adaptation, and deployment of large models across multi-architecture AI chips.

sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-MLX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.
